name: koru-autopilot-vscodium
description: Bridge between VSCodium / Code - OSS and the koru autopilot daemon. Standalone VSIX for VSCodium / Code - OSS only — sibling packages cover other IDEs so regressions cannot leak across runtimes.

commands.title: koru: Send text to active chat

koruAutopilot.socketPath.description: Unix socket override. Empty = KORU_AUTOPILOT_SOCKET, else KORU_AUTOPILOT_INSTANCE / XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (matches koru Python).

koruAutopilot.chatOpenCommands.description: Commands to open AI chat, tried in order (Cursor Composer, Copilot Chat, …). Empty = extension defaults.

koruAutopilot.autoConnect.description: Connect to the daemon automatically when the editor starts.

koruAutopilot.openChatOnConnect.description: After connecting to the koru daemon, open/focus the existing AI chat surface without sending text. The extension uses the configured chatOpenCommands/default focus ladder and does not request a new agent/chat mode.

koruAutopilot.quietLayoutBeforeChatFocus.description: Before focusing chat, close active utility editors such as Settings/Search/Extensions and hide the bottom Panel (Terminal/Output/Problems) so paste/submit cannot land there. Side Bar and Auxiliary Bar are left visible because chat often lives there.

koruAutopilot.probeLadder.description: Try chat commands in order with focus/paste verification; cache winning command IDs per IDE.

koruAutopilot.probeFocusDelayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after a focus-open command before verifying UI state.

koruAutopilot.probePasteDelayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after paste before checking the text did not land in a file editor.

koruAutopilot.submitClickX.description: Optional absolute screen X coordinate for clicking the chat Send button after paste. Use command `koru: Capture submit button position`.

koruAutopilot.submitClickY.description: Optional absolute screen Y coordinate for clicking the chat Send button after paste. Use command `koru: Capture submit button position`.

koruAutopilot.chatHistoryWatch.description: Cursor only: poll the chat-history SQLite DB and forward newly observed assistant messages as 'message.received' events to the koru daemon. Without this, koru cannot tell whether the IDE-side LLM has answered, asked a follow-up question, or finished the task.

koruAutopilot.chatHistoryPollIntervalMs.description: Cursor only: how often (ms) to poll Cursor's chat-history SQLite DB for new assistant messages.

koruAutopilot.skipWhenInputBusy.description: Before pasting into chat, probe via select-all + copy to detect un-submitted text in the chat input. When non-empty, skip the drive instead of clobbering the user's reply or concatenating prompts. Disable to restore the legacy 'always paste on top' behavior.

koruAutopilot.submitHostKey.description: Host-level key combo used to submit the chat after paste. 'auto' picks Ctrl+Return for Cursor (where plain Return inserts a newline) and Return otherwise. Override to force a specific key.

koruAutopilot.trustUnverifiedHostSubmit.description: For VSCodium on Linux, treat a successful host Return/Ctrl+Return submit key as accepted when VS Code APIs cannot verify chat submission. Disabled by default because unverified host keys can target the wrong IDE surface.

koruAutopilot.allowVSCodiumHostInputFall.description: Allow VSCodium to use OS-level keyboard fallbacks after registered chat submit commands no-op. Enabled by default because the fallback is accepted only when plugin verification proves the chat input was cleared after submit.

koruAutopilot.verifySubmit.description: After every submit candidate (registered IDE command or host-level Return/Ctrl+Return), probe the chat input via select-all + copy. If the trailing portion of the pasted prompt is still present, discard the cached winner and try the next candidate. Applies to Cursor, VS Code, VSCodium, and other plugin-ladder IDEs. Skipped for Windsurf/Antigravity native atomic send paths.

koruAutopilot.verifySubmitOnCursor.description: Deprecated alias for koruAutopilot.verifySubmit (kept for settings migration).

koruAutopilot.windsurfKeepOpenAfterSend.description: After using Windsurf's native sendTextToChat command, run extra Cascade open commands. Disabled by default because those commands can toggle the right chat column closed when it is already open.

koruAutopilot.reloadOnVersionMismatch.description: When the koru daemon rejects this plugin because the installed VSIX version or build hash does not match the daemon's expected plugin, run `Developer: Reload Window` automatically so the freshly installed VSIX gets loaded. The plugin enforces a 60s cooldown so it never reloads more than once per minute. Set to false to keep the manual recovery (status bar shows `koru: reload`).

scripts.test: npm run compile && node out/dispatch-plan.test.js && node out/probe-ladder.test.js && node out/step-decisions.test.js && node out/host-click-submit.test.js && node out/chat-history-watcher.test.js && node out/ack-payload.test.js && node out/command-catalog.test.js && node out/ides/vscodium.test.js && node out/extension.test.js
scripts.prepackage: python3 ../../scripts/sync-plugin-shared.py --plugin koru-autopilot-vscodium && python3 ../../scripts/sync-plugin-build.py --plugin koru-autopilot-vscodium && python3 ../../scripts/sync-plugin-version.py --plugin koru-autopilot-vscodium
